changes: In-App Auto-Update Fix: Added backwards-compatible script.sh alias and validated HTTP 200 responses to prevent corrupted download handling.
Single Source of Truth Installer: Updated installer to read and parse version directly from version.json.
24-Hour Update Check Rate-Limiting: Automatic background launch update check now respects a strict 24-hour rate limit so it checks at most once per day without pestering.
Smooth Update Window Scrolling: Introduced hardware-accelerated SwiftUI ScrollView changelog viewer for 60 FPS / 120 FPS ProMotion trackpad scrolling.
Real-Time Update Check: Purged URLCache and added cache-busting timestamp parameters for zero-delay update notifications.
Cumulative Release Notes: Update alert now parses and displays all unread changes since your current build.
1-Click In-App Auto-Update: Automatically downloads installer and runs Terminal auto-update flow.
Standardized bundle identifier to com.aoh.snapback across app bundle, Info.plist, and installer.
Fixed CI build pipeline and homebrew tap workflow.
Initial Release: Snap Back v1.0.0 is here!
Window Layout Saving: Instantly capture the exact position and size of every open window.
One-Click Restoration: Restore your entire workspace layout with a single click.
Smart Browser Tab Restoration: Automatically re-opens tabs for Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Arc, and all Chromium browsers.
Visual Previews: See a screenshot snapshot of your saved layout before restoring.
Profile Management: Save multiple named profiles (e.g., 'Work', 'Trading', 'Design') to switch contexts instantly.
Privacy-First Architecture: All data is stored locally in your Pictures folder. No cloud, no tracking.
Native Performance: Built with Swift and AppleScript for lightning-fast execution and zero dependencies.
Self-Contained Installer: Single-file build script generates a custom interactive installer app.
